entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You have the gun with you, right?[n]Point it at a Shadow and fire!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Point it at a Shadow and fire!
Press the up button to draw your gun,[n]then press the [clr 2]○ button[clr 27] to fire.
From there you can press the left or[n]right buttons to switch targets until[n]you run out of ammunition.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There are plenty of instances where[n]rapid fire's going to be more useful[n]than swinging your knife.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Of course, you can run out of ammo,[n]but using it all up does more good[n]than letting it collect dust!
The gun is a powerful weapon, but[n]each person has a maximum amount[n]of ammunition they can carry.
This ammunition will not replenish[n]within a Palace, but will do so[n]automatically upon exiting.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, I'll show you my weapon too!
